lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, varying in diameter, arranged in roughly vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like appearance across the central visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge to a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots localized primarily within its anterior and central silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface contains a much higher density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the primary lateral flank patterning.
